normal_civic_discussion_v1.name: Normal Civic Discussion
normal_civic_discussion_v1.description: Ordinary civic discussion period with broader tolerance for political opinion, satire, and non-actionable claims.

rules.candidate_claims: Candidate claims may be allowed or contextualized unless they provide actionable election misinformation.
rules.voting_procedure: Voting procedure claims should be reviewed when actionable, but ordinary discussion receives broader tolerance.
rules.satire: Satire is generally allowed when the satirical framing is clear.
rules.ballot_validity: Unverified ballot validity claims should be contextualized unless they instruct people not to vote.
rules.counting_process: Claims about counting process may be contextualized when non-actionable.

election_integrity_period_v2.name: Election Integrity Period
election_integrity_period_v2.description: Heightened integrity period where misleading election procedure, eligibility, ballot validity, timing, location, and counting claims are restricted or escalated.

rules.candidate_claims: Misleading candidate eligibility claims near election day should be restricted or escalated.
rules.voting_procedure: False or unverified voting time, location, or procedure claims should be removed.
rules.satire: Satire is allowed only when clearly non-deceptive and unlikely to mislead voters.
rules.ballot_validity: False ballot validity claims should be removed or escalated.
rules.counting_process: False counting process claims should be restricted, removed, or escalated.
